text: mike: Noticed a regression after switching kernel-selector fallback rules -> p95 host-side for 1-3 token requests up ~10% across small vclusters. quick dump attached. anya: Which changes rolled yesterday? kernel weights or batching heuristics? kevin: Both: we changed the kernel latency weight and enabled adaptive mini-coalesce (aim to reduce cold kernel pops). rachel: Got a flame briefly: top stacks look like tokenize_host, kernel_score.compute, grpc_writev_wait. tokenize_host is 18% which is higher than expected. mike: Also saw KV miss rate spike on hosts with the regression. Hit-rate went from 98% -> 84% in the windows. kevin: Hypothesis: adaptive coalesce oscillation causes repeated kernel re-scoring and re-tokenization for the same request if we re-dispatch. rachel: Logs show some requests have "preparse:tokenized=true" but the dispatch path still calls tokenize when batch size changes. mike: That explains duplicate work. we also see writev backpressure when many small writes occur (smallwrites pattern up 3x). infra-bot: deploy-bot: kernel-selector v2 rolled to prod at 2026-02-15T03:12:05Z. anya: Mitigations proposal: 1) add pretokenized short-circuit in dispatch, 2) cache kernel_score keyed by (model_id, seq_bucket, hw_family) for 10s with LRU, 3) dampen mini-coalesce oscillation (add hysteresis). kevin: Quick patch: skip scoring if request has header pretokenized=true OR if last_score_ts < now - 5s. cheap to deploy. rachel: Also consider adding a threshold: only re-score if batch_size delta >= 4 tokens — avoids noise from tiny coalesce. mike: Agree. let's canary pretokenize+kernel-cache on one vcluster and monitor p95 + kv-hit. infra-bot: canary-manager: started canary on vcluster-03 (15% traffic) with config: host.accepts_pretokenized=true, kernel.cache_ttl=5s, ingress.coalesce_hysteresis=4. kevin: I'll also flip grpc writev aggregation to coalesce small writes into single writev in the proxy for hosts in canary. should reduce HPACK churn. anya: Good call. please add tcpdump for 2 minutes after canary flips so we can inspect http2 frames. rachel: Telemetry additions: emit metric kernel_score_calls_total, tokenize_dedupe_hits, grpc_writev_block_ms per host. mike: Running 20m smoke now. If p95 improves and kv-hit stabilizes, we promote. infra-bot: perf-alert: after 9m, canary p95 down 11%, kv hit-rate returned to ~96%, grpc smallwrites down 60%. monitoring: 20m window. kevin: Nice. After promoted, we should include a note in the release: "Avoid double-tokenization by honoring preparse tokenization; cache kernel scoring for hot buckets; add coalesce hysteresis". anya: Filing follow-ups: ticket for strict dispatch pretokenize guard, task for kernel-score telemetry, and ramp plan. mike: Thanks team. Will watch the 20m and then rollout if stable.
